title.narrative: Integrating Biodiversity Conservation into Upstream Planning of Linear Transport Infrastructure in Ukraine

description.narrative: Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.
To advance the transition towards sustainable transportation infrastructure that safeguard and enhance key terrestrial ecosystems in Ukraine

We confirm that the child project design has considered socio-economic benefits to be delivered by the project and these have been clearly described in the Project Description and will be monitored and reported on during project implementation (at MTR and TER). The stakeholders (authorities, scientific institutions and communities) will benefit in any case, as the project will lead to the development of the necessary monitoring and legal mechanisms to integrate biodiversity protection into the rehabilitation/construction of linear transport infrastructure during the long-term reconstruction phase in the future. The established legal framework will not only reduce the pressure on biodiversity, but will also be more attractive to donors and investors for long-term and large-scale rehabilitation and construction projects. In addition, the development of logistics is one of the priority factors for the development of the Ukrainian economy.
